or 130-220 (210-300) |id = 14857,14858 }} '''[[Gryphon|Gryphons]]''' can be assigned as a slayer task by [[Vannaka]], [[Chaeldar]] and [[Mortimer]] after completion of the [[Troubled Tortugans]] quest. Additionally, both [[Nieve]] and [[Duradel]] may assign gryphons after the perk '''Wings Spread''' has been purchased. Gryphons are found exclusively on [[The Great Conch]] (Fairy Ring CJQ). There are three lairs for gryphons; a western cavern, an eastern cavern ([[Slayer task]] only) and a [[Shellbane Gryphon Cave|lair]] in the centre of the island which leads to the [[Shellbane gryphon]]. Both the eastern and western caverns have a southern room that is multi-combat and cannon-able. Gryphons attack with melee and have a special attack which causes knockback and moderate damage if the player's weight of their worn equipment is too low; this is 30 for normal gryphons and 40 for the boss. They are weakest to melee, ideally from stabbing attacks. While being a bit more resistant to magic, they have a 50% weakness to [[air spells]]. Bringing the [[tortugan shield]] is not necessary for normal gryphons, but those who are fighting their superior, the [[dire gryphon]], or the boss are required to use it, or their attacks will deal frequent and moderate damage, even through prayer. Dire gryphons are similar to the boss variant in mechanics. A boss variant, the Shellbane gryphon, can be found in the centre lair and is only attackable on-task. It is a solo instanced boss and alongside melee, makes use of ranged attacks and also two additional special attacks, both of which are easily avoidable. Gryphons have relatively poor drops (except [[Horn of Plenty]]), and players who are not planning to kill the boss should otherwise avoid toggling them on for Nieve/Duradel. The boss itself has somewhat lacklustre drops too, but is slightly better compared to normal gryphons and has several unique items to collect. For players seeking [[gryphon]] tasks, they are recommended to use Vannaka; while the overall amount is lower than Duradel, gryphons are Vannaka's highest weighted task. ==Slayer unlocks== {{Main|Slayer Rewards}} {|class="wikitable sortable lighttable align-center-1 align-center-3" ! colspan="2" | Unlock ! Points cost ! Notes |- |[[File:Bigger and Badder.png|link=]] |Bigger and Badder |50 |Increase the risk against certain slayer monsters with the chance of a [[Superior slayer monster|superior version]] spawning whilst on a slayer task. |- |[[File:Gryphon icon.png|link=]] |Wings Spread |80 |Nieve and Duradel will be able to assign [[Gryphon]]s as your task. |- |[[File:Gryphon icon.png|link=]] |Gryphon and on |50 |Number of [[gryphons]] assigned is increased by 80. |} ==Equipment== {{Equipment |align = right |head = Slayer helmet (i) |cape = Dizana's quiver |neck = Necklace of rupture |ammo = Rada's blessing 4 |ammo2 = Amethyst arrow |weapon = Venator bow |torso = Masori body (f) |legs = Masori chaps (f) |shield = |gloves = Barrows gloves |boots = Echo boots |ring = Ring of the gods (i) }} Players who are not safespotting gryphons are recommended to use melee equipment. A minimum of 30 kg is required for normal gryphons and 40 for the shellbane gryphon to avoid taking damage from their special attack. They are best killed in the south-western multicombat room of the eastern task-only cave using a [[venator bow]] and a [[dwarf multicannon]]. 30 kg can be reached in a maxed range setup by using a [[black mask (i)]] rather than a [[slayer helmet (i)]], using a [[granite ring]], or by substituting [[avernic treads (max)]] for [[echo boots]].
